HERMES_AGENT.auth_probe: hermes doctor (diagnostic readiness probe); credentials are never copied into MCF payloads
HERMES_AGENT.interrupt: OS process cancellation; terminal result exit_code is reconciled with observed process state

KILO_CODE.permission_enforcement: adapter must configure native permissions so terminal/command operations are controller-mediated or fail admission
KILO_CODE.auth_probe: readiness probe; kilo auth is interactive configuration, so the adapter must not treat its invocation as a machine-readable auth result

OPEN_CODE.environment_rationale: OPENCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE (OpenCode's own documented variable name) stops OpenCode ingesting ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and .claude/skills. Those paths are outside Mayasaba-authorized scope and must never act as an instruction source. Default plugins and autoupdate are disabled so adapter behavior stays deterministic and offline.
OPEN_CODE.permission_enforcement: do not pass --auto; select an explicit agent via --agent whose permission map denies privileged operations, otherwise fail admission for tasks requiring execution mediation
OPEN_CODE.auth_probe: readiness probe; opencode auth login is interactive configuration, so the adapter must not treat its invocation as a machine-readable auth result
OPEN_CODE.output_contract: run --format accepts default|json and emits a raw JSON event stream, not a fixed-shape document; the adapter must normalize the typed event sequence and must not assume a single result object
